repeat_policy: one paired pass on 102 units; three Decision repeats on panel 18; three upstream realizations on panel 9; r0 shared with main
exposure_policy: no Full exposure calibration/control in this profile; claims requiring it are withdrawn
failure_policy: archive and stop shard; no fallback model or synthetic prediction; resume node cache under identical hashes
sentiment_policy: new pinned local scores on deduplicated cache; date-only next day; publication/content PIT unverified; no peers
ledger_scope: fractional, daily close MTM, immediate cash, no tax/dividend/settlement/fill feasibility certification; continuous hold is price-only
inference_scope: descriptive effect distributions; folds/dates/repeats are dependent, not independent market observations; no superiority p-value
acceptance_scope: common-snapshot baseline evidence for R1; does not close R2/R3/R6/R9/R15 release gates or establish prospective validity
